summary: Wrappers ai-gemini and ai-glm now resolve caller from explicit AI_*_CALLER (or --caller) or harness detection (mimo/claude/codex/zcode) and fail closed with caller_identity_missing instead of defaulting to codex/claude. Under MiMo, caller=mimo is auto-detected from MIMO_* process markers. Residual: shared-db run-governed-review.mjs detectReviewCaller still only knows claude/codex and throws before spawning the wrapper; that launcher fix is out of scope for this repo.
